English

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • (UK) IPA(key): /ˈɹəʊbəʊ/
  • Audio (Southern England):(file)
  • (US) IPA(key): /ˈɹoʊboʊ/
  • Rhymes: -əʊbəʊ

Noun

[edit]

robo (plural robos)

  1. (informal) A robot.
    I am not a robo.

[edit]
